findings.message: The container setup omits development dependencies, leaving developers unable to run the test suite. postCreateCommand installs '.[dev]', but pyproject.toml selects hatchling.build and defines no dev optional dependency. The dev extra in setup.py is not read by Hatchling, and requirements-dev.in is never installed. In a fresh container, the setup therefore omits pytest and pytest-asyncio, which tests/test_server.py requires.

Opening a checkout with a different directory name fails because the configured workspace path does not match its mount. workspaceFolder is fixed to /workspaces/ProxmoxMCP-Plus without a workspaceMount override. A checkout named proxmox-dev is mounted by default at /workspaces/proxmox-dev, leaving the configured workspace and postCreateCommand working directory nonexistent. Line 20 also fixes the interpreter to the unmatched path.
